book.title: Computer Organization and Design, Enhanced
book.author: David A. Patterson and John L. Hennessy

predict.question: After the last stage rises to 8, other capacities stay 8 and 6. What is throughput?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Pipeline performance depends on the capacities of its stages.
modelBoundary: The original gives {A}; the upgrade gives {B}. Decode now limits output, so doubling one stage does not double the whole pipeline.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This is an ideal serial abstraction, not a CPU simulation. Hazards, latency and buffering are omitted.
